T1.implementation_approach: Set up version control, install necessary dependencies, and configure the development environment.
T1.notes: Ensure all team members have the same environment setup.

T2.implementation_approach: Create wireframes and implement a responsive UI for creating notes using a frontend framework.

T3.implementation_approach: Develop API endpoints to handle note creation and integrate with the database.
T3.notes: Ensure proper validation and error handling.

T4.implementation_approach: Design a drag-and-drop or categorized UI for organizing notes.
T4.notes: Consider user-friendly interactions for organizing notes efficiently.

T5.implementation_approach: Implement backend logic to support note organization, including updating categories or positions in the database.
T5.notes: Optimize for performance with large datasets.

T6.implementation_approach: Design a search bar with filters and sorting options for finding notes.
T6.notes: Ensure the UI is intuitive and responsive.

T7.implementation_approach: Develop backend search functionality using database queries or a search engine like Elasticsearch.
T7.notes: Focus on fast and accurate search results.

T8.implementation_approach: Define database schema with tables for notes, categories, and metadata.
T8.notes: Ensure scalability and normalization where necessary.

T9.implementation_approach: Write unit tests to validate note creation functionality, including edge cases.
T9.notes: Use a testing framework like Jest or Pytest.

T10.implementation_approach: Develop unit tests to verify the organization logic and database updates.
T10.notes: Test for both valid and invalid scenarios.

T11.implementation_approach: Write unit tests to ensure search functionality returns correct and relevant results.
T11.notes: Include tests for performance and edge cases.

T12.implementation_approach: Deploy the application to a staging environment using CI/CD pipelines.
T12.notes: Ensure the staging environment mirrors production closely.

T13.implementation_approach: Perform end-to-end testing to validate the entire workflow from note creation to search.
T13.notes: Use tools like Selenium or Cypress for automation.

T14.implementation_approach: Deploy the application to the production environment after final approval.
T14.notes: Monitor the deployment for any issues post-launch.
